title: A Recursion Backbone for Circular and Elliptic Clausen Hierarchies
summary: We introduce an elliptic extension of Clausen-type functions based on a unified recursive framework. Starting from the polylogarithmic master function, we construct a pair of circular functions whose real and imaginary parts correspond to the classical Clausen-type structures. Replacing the trigonometric seed with a Jacobi theta function yields an elliptic deformation that preserves the same recursive backbone.
